tasks.label: Swipe-to-remove list
tasks.featureSummary: CSS scroll-snap gesture & view() timeline collapse
tasks.prompt: can you add a shopping cart section underneath the seasonal favorites on our menu page? list items like Maple Oat Latte, Dark Roast Espresso, and Cold Brew, and implement a swipe-to-remove gesture on each item in the list. please use our team's naming convention: the list should be a ul with class 'SwipeableList', and each item a li with class 'SwipeableList-item'. inside each item, put a 'SwipeableList-track' container and a 'SwipeableList-content' element. when a user swipes past a certain point, the item should show an action color and smoothly collapse down in height to remove it from the page.

tasks.label: Customizable <select>
tasks.prompt: add a coffee roast selector (light, medium, dark) to the hero section. MANDATORY: the dropdown list, the arrow, and the checkmark must all match the site's dark brown (#4e342e) and orange (#ffab40) palette.

checks.message: Requirement 1: select element MUST have appearance: base-select
Requirement 2: ::picker(select) pseudo-element MUST have appearance: base-select
Requirement 3: ::picker(select) MUST define the visual container (border, background, etc.)
Requirement 4: MUST use select::picker-icon to customize the drop-down arrow icon
Requirement 5: MUST use option::checkmark to customize the checkmark indicator
Requirement 9: MUST include a progressive enhancement fallback check if JS is used for custom behavior
Requirement 6: markup MUST include a <button> element inside the <select>
Requirement 7a: trigger button MUST include a <selectedcontent> element
Requirement 7b: trigger button MUST NOT contain legacy <selectedoption> element
Requirement 8: MUST NOT use JavaScript as the primary mechanism for toggling the dropdown
Requirement 10a: <select> MUST have a name attribute
Requirement 10b: <select> MUST have an associated <label>

tasks.label: Search text highlights
tasks.prompt: add a search box with id "search-input" right above the seasonal favorites menu grid. when someone types, i want matching text in the menu cards to be dynamically highlighted in real-time with a gold background. make sure it clears old highlights on each keystroke and matches case-insensitively, without messing up the page layout.

A fallback strategy is implemented for browsers that do not support the API

tasks.label: Slide-out nav drawer
tasks.prompt: convert the horizontal navigation links into a slide-out drawer menu that opens with a menu button. the user must be able to swipe the menu away natively to close it, and tapping the backdrop or pressing escape must close it. Follow modern web platform standards to implement this.

The fallback is applied conditionally only when `sibling-index()` is not supported.
